text:
erin_cs: FYI customer_acme hit partial JSON in streaming JSON mode. They say stream cut off mid-object and client parse fails. Posting thread for escalation.

customer_acme: Hi team, here's a minimal repro from our side. We call your hosted /v1/streams endpoint and get JSON that ends in the middle of an object: 

curl -N -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" -H "Accept: text/event-stream" \n  -d '{"model":"gpt-open-1","json_schema":{...},"stream":true}' \n  https://api.redwood-inference.com/v1/streams/generate

Response snippet (last 2 chunks):

data: {"event":"response.delta","delta":"{\"choices\":[{\"index\":0,\"delta\":{\"content\":\"...\\n  \"status\": \"success\", \"result\": { \"id\": \"abc123\", \"value\": 42","type":"delta"}

data: [TRUNCATED BY CONNECTION]

We attempted to re-run and sometimes get the final brace, sometimes not. Request-id: rwd-req-2026-11-01-01. Region: us-west-2. Customer is behind a corporate proxy that does TLS termination + re-streaming.

jason_support: Thanks @erin_cs and @customer_acme — we'll triage. Two quick asks: can you paste the raw response with headers (curl -i) and confirm whether the proxy inserts or strips any headers (Connection, Transfer-Encoding)? Also, was this over HTTP/2 or HTTP/1.1?

erin_cs: customer provided raw headers: 

HTTP/1.1 200 OK
Content-Type: text/event-stream; charset=utf-8
Transfer-Encoding: chunked
Connection: keep-alive
X-Request-Id: rwd-req-2026-11-01-01

Proxy logs show repeated: "upstream connection reset by peer" and a windowed timeout on the re-streaming connection (proxy name: corp-proxy-01).

lee_sre: This looks like an intermediate proxy closing the TCP stream before the server finished sending the final chunk. Three likely causes:
- proxy max idle/tunnel timeout shorter than our server's finalization time (esp. if server sends an open stream heartbeat then final payload),
- proxy mishandling of chunked SSE boundaries when re-streaming (loss of last chunk),
- a client-side keepalive issue causing re-open during final flush.

Quick repro suggestion: try curl with --no-buffer and --http1.1 behind the same proxy to see deterministic behavior: 

curl -v --no-buffer --http1.1 -H "Accept: text/event-stream" -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" \n  -d '{"stream":true,...}' https://api.redwood-inference.com/v1/streams/generate

Also capture tcpdump on the proxy to confirm FIN/RST timing. If you see the proxy send FIN before the final SSE chunk, it's the proxy.

jason_support: For immediate mitigation while infra investigates, we can offer two short-term workarounds: 
1) Switch the client to NDJSON streaming (each top-level object newline-delimited) — proxies tend to handle ndjson more robustly since each object is self-contained. Request param: "stream_format=ndjson" (we can enable for their account).
2) Enable server-side keepalive heartbeats every 10s (we have an internal flag) so proxy tunnel stays active until final flush. This adds a few bytes periodically: 

  // server-side canary option (internal)
  X-Stream-Heartbeat: 10s

I'll scope an account-level toggle for (1) and (2) and roll a canary.

opsbot: paging lee_sre (oncall) — escalation rwd-req-2026-11-01-01, channel support.

lee_sre: I'm on it. I checked ingress HAProxy and saw several connections from corp-proxy-01 with "server closed connection" while our backend still had bytes queued. I recommend increasing the proxy tunnel timeout and enabling chunked passthrough on their proxy. Short-term, I'll deploy a canary that inserts SSE comment keepalives every 8s for sessions from that customer to reduce the chance of an early FIN.

erin_cs: Customer asked whether we can also provide a signed curl example that uses --http1.1 and --no-buffer to reproduce. I'll send that and coordinate the toggle with customer. They can't change their proxy config immediately.

customer_acme: Appreciate the quick turnaround. NDJSON toggle sounds fine as a fallback. Will test canary later today and post results.

jason_support: Thanks everyone — I'll update the ticket with the canary id and next steps. If the canary stabilizes streams for corp-proxy-01 we'll schedule a permanent config: either NDJSON by default for that account or long-term keepalive heartbeats.

erin_cs: marking this as escalated -> infra. Keeping account team looped. :thumbsup:
